what_is_tested: the IMPLEMENTATION of the polyhedral union oracle against the naive extrema-region oracle.  The identity itself is LeanFunctionalRangeAlternativeUnionV1, not this script.
qp_method: solved through the dual  max_{y>=0} y^T(A mu - b) - (1/2) y^T A M^{-1} A^T y,  with lam = mu - M^{-1} A^T y; primal feasibility, stationarity, complementary slackness and the duality gap are all reported per instance
not_established: Agreement validates the implementation of the union identity.  It does NOT prove the identity; that is the Lean module.
A fixed uniform design is used: this is an ORACLE test, not a design optimisation.  The outer sup over designs is not attempted here.
Floating-point QPs: the residual and gap columns are what make each value auditable.  No value here is an exact certificate.
k = 1.  Larger k changes the Top-k boundary and is not tested.
